A cracked display, lines across the screen or touch that won't respond? The right repair starts with your exact phone model and what you can see.

Sound familiar?

  • Cracked glass or marks across the display
  • Missing areas, lines or unusual colours
  • Touch that misses taps or responds on its own

Useful things to ask us

  • Which display options fit my exact model?
  • What will the part, fit and touch performance be like?
  • What are the cost, timing and applicable warranty terms?

GOOD QUESTIONS. CLEAR ANSWERS.

A little clarity.
Before you visit.

Still wondering about something?
We're only a message away.

How much will my repair cost?

It depends on your phone model, the fault and the parts required. Send us your model and symptoms on WhatsApp, or visit for a check. Ask the team to explain the cost and options before agreeing to any work.

How long does a repair take?

Timing varies with the issue, parts availability and the work involved. Contact us with your phone model and ask for an expected turnaround. We don't quote a fixed repair time online.

Can you help with my phone model?

Share the brand and exact model, along with what's wrong. We'll discuss the repair options and parts availability for your device. The brands shown on this website are for identification and do not imply manufacturer affiliation.

What should I do before bringing my phone?

Back up your data if the phone still works, note the issue and bring any relevant charging accessories. Remove your SIM and memory card if you don't need them for the check. Never send passwords or one-time codes over WhatsApp.

Where exactly is the shop?

Ahmed Parts is at Gate No. 12, Shop A-238, Sareena Mobile Market, Karachi. Call 0311 3433389 if you need help finding us, and confirm opening hours before travelling.

What should I ask about replacement parts?

Ask which part options are available for your exact model, how the options differ, and what the quote includes. Discuss fit, appearance, performance and any applicable warranty terms before deciding.

Can I ask a question before visiting?

Absolutely. Use the repair enquiry on this page to prepare a WhatsApp message, or call 0311 3433389. Include your phone model and what you notice. A message helps start the conversation; an in-person check may still be needed to confirm the fault.
